---
name: Bug report
about: Something broke
labels: bug
---

**What happened / what did you expect?**

**Capture (per DOGFOOD.md):**

- the exact command + stderr
- `chat status` and `chat doctor` output
- `cat .git/hooks/pre-push` from the repo (if hook-related)
- OS + `chat --version` + `claude --version` / codex version

**Did any session data end up wrong?** (diverged/conflict states are usually
by design — see README "Working from any laptop" — but tell us anyway.)
